build_package_habitat_baselines: build a python package for habitat-baselines by running setup.py with pip install
collect_requirements_recursive: collect all requirements from requirements.txt files in habitat_baselines subdirectories recursively
get_package_version: get the current package version by importing VERSION from habitat_baselines version module
read_file_content: read the contents of a file like README.md with specified encoding and return as string
install_console_script: install the habitat-baselines console script entry point that calls habitat_baselines.run.main
